# Base image with Flux, OpenMPI, and AWS EFA support for ARM
FROM ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm

# Set the version of OSU benchmarks to build
ARG OSU_VERSION=7.3

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install build dependencies, download, compile, and install OSU benchmarks
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    wget \
    automake \
    autoconf \
    ca-certificates && \
    # Create a temporary source directory
    mkdir -p /usr/src/osu && \
    cd /usr/src/osu && \
    # Download the OSU benchmarks source code
    wget "https://mvapich.cse.ohio-state.edu/download/mvapich/osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
    tar -xvf "osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
    cd "osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}" && \
    # Configure the build to use the MPI compilers provided by the base image
    ./configure CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx && \
    # Build the benchmarks using all available cores
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    # Find all compiled MPI benchmark executables and copy them to a system PATH location
    find c/mpi -name "osu_*" -type f -executable -exec cp {} /usr/local/bin/ \; && \
    # Clean up source files to reduce image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /usr/src/osu && \
    # Clean up apt cache
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default command to display the help message for a common benchmark
CMD ["osu_allreduce", "-h"]

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run the OSU All-Reduce benchmark
# on an AWS EKS cluster with ARM-based instances and EFA networking.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: osu-allreduce-aws-arm
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Specify the size of the MiniCluster, corresponding to 4 pods to run on 4 nodes.
  size: 4

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run for the benchmark.
  # With a size of 4, this will run one task per node.
  tasks: 4

  # Do not automatically delete the job resources upon completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Enable strict mode for logging, which provides more detailed validation and debugging info.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Flux-specific configuration section.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture as ARM for AWS Graviton instances.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # Specify the ARM-compatible flux-view image, as required for the architecture.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy
      # Disable the Flux sidecar container. Flux will run within the main application container.
      disable: true

  # Define the main application container. Only one container is needed.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:osu-allreduce
      # The command to execute. The Flux operator will automatically prepend `flux run`.
      command: osu_allreduce

      # Ensure the latest image is used for every execution.
      imagePullPolicy: Always

      # This container does not launch the job; the Flux Operator handles that.
      launcher: false

      # Request AWS EFA network devices for high-performance internode communication.
      # The value "1" requests one EFA device per pod.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

manager.name: Build and Deploy OSU AllReduce
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.environment: AWS CPU instance in Kubernetes to run across nodes
context.details:
You MUST use ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm as a base image. It includes OpenMPI and libfabric provided from the efa installer for AWS and the entire Flux Framework stack.
You MUST compile setting the cxx compiler to mpicxx and the c compiler to mpicc.
Build the OSU benchmarks. You MUST have MPI support enabled. You MUST ensure osu_allreduce is on the path.
You MUST build for a multi-node MPI environment

context.resources: The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. You must add the nodeSelector to use node.kubernetes.io/instance-type m7g.16xlarge with 64 CPU, 256 GiB Memory, ARM (Graviton3). You are limited to up to 4 nodes.
context.details:
Run The OSU All Reduce benchmark across 4 nodes. 
You MUST run on up to 4 nodes and you MUST set flux.container.disable to true.
You MUST set the containers imagePullPolicy to Always.
The Flux Operator uses flux run in the pwd with the tasks determined by the spec.tasks.
You MUST set resource requests and limits to use vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
Since this is an ARM instance you MUST change the flux.container.image to be
ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy and set flux.arch: "arm".
